title: The dominating geometric partial sums 2*sum(1/2)^i form a Cauchy sequence
statement: Cauchy (sumRange expDominant), expDominant n := mul two (pow half n) -- built via converges_mul (a constant sequence times the geometric partial sums, both convergent) plus cauchyOfPointwiseEquiv transported across mul_sumRange's Equiv, rather than re-deriving CReal.mul's own index-shift bookkeeping by hand. This is the 'domination bridge' theorem this batch's brief names by its informal title expDominantCauchy.
